label: late copy-phase input of w/b/m/t/g
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on <DEL>), when the fed-back input token is one of w, b, m, t, g (in order of rate: w 8.2x, b 6.5x, m 5.0x, t 4.1x, g 2.9x lift), and much more often late in the copy (recall_idx >= 4; rate rises steadily to 11% at the last step, and about half the mass is on the final output step). The predicate covers ~82% of activation mass on dev but precision is only ~0.24: most late copy-phase w/b/m/t/g inputs stay below threshold, and adding conditions on the output token or steps remaining did not raise precision much (best about 0.35). The strongest activations are w/b/m inputs at the last one or two copy steps. Weak residual firing on other inputs (z, j, 0, a) and earlier copy positions.
